messages:
maya (sales): Indra is ready to spin up a POC. They want hosted API keys but insist on auto-rotation and a webhook alert each time a key is rotated. Can we provide a minimal secure flow they can implement?

leo (solutions): Minimal pattern: our provisioning endpoint issues an ephemeral key + one-time client_secret. Customer stores secret in their vault. They run a short-lived renewal job that: call provision -> update vault -> hit our rotate callback (optional) -> revoke old key. We support a rotation callback URL on create that posts JSON when a key is issued.

leo (solutions): Create example (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision/keys" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROVISION_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"customer":"indra","type":"ephemeral","ttl_seconds":86400,"scopes":["generation:invoke"],"rotation_callback":"https://hooks.indra.example/rotations","ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.0/22"]}'
# returns {"key_id":"k_...","client_secret":"..."}
```

reza (security): Notes: 24h TTL OK for higher security POCs. Rotation callback must be TLS and verify our POSTs via HMAC header (we sign with provision-token). Do not accept anonymous webhooks. Revoke endpoint requires admin token. All ops logged to audit trail.

maya (sales): Can we limit issuance rate so they don't spam keys during testing?

leo (solutions): Yes — we set a per-org issuance cap (default 10 per hour). If they need higher for automation testing, we can bump it per-request.

indra (customer): We want the callback to include key_id and expiry only, not the secret. We'll pull the secret from your create response into our vault. Is that supported?

leo (solutions): Callback payload contains metadata (key_id, customer, expires_at, scopes). Client_secret is never sent to callbacks. Good pattern.

deploy-bot: Policy check: requires audit_tag=pocex:indra and approver=reza. Issuance rate=10/hr applied.

reza (security): Approved for 24h TTL with HMAC-signed callbacks and IP allowlist 198.51.100.0/22. Reminder: vault rotation job must perform create -> verify vault update -> revoke old key to avoid gap.

maya (sales): Action: leo to provision initial key and paste final curl to Indra; reza to sign off on HMAC secret exchange; maya to send runbook with webhook example.

indra (customer): Thanks — we'll wire the webhook and run a daily job to rotate. Will confirm once webhook is live. :pray:

maya (sales): Great, keep us posted.
